title: One fish with changing weather
note: Single static logo concept with weather transitioning across its interior and a simplified Lake Billy Chinook-inspired cream cutout.
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand, compositing edit.
Input image: the attached four-fish concept board is the source design reference. It must become ONE SINGLE LOGO, containing exactly ONE right-facing fish. This is the user's correction: "in one logo, like the weather is changing throughout the inside of one logo fish."

Create ONE large, polished Oregon Fish Forecast brand lockup on a plain warm paper background #F5F2E9. One trout above the exact two-line dark blue wordmark "OREGON" / "FISH FORECAST". No heading, captions, labels, grid, alternate versions, duplicate fish, or footer.

The one fish is a continuous landscape window in which the WEATHER CHANGES ACROSS ITS INTERIOR. All the conditions coexist within this ONE fish. Across the upper body and dorsal fin, flow from warm clear golden sunlight on the left, through soft blue and white clouds across the middle, into a slate blue rain shower at center-right, finishing with an icy blue snowy mountain atmosphere toward the right. Use a single connected sky and a single continuous evergreen mountain-and-forest landscape; overlap cloud shapes and gradually change sky and land colors so the transitions feel natural. NO vertical dividers, slices, panels, rectangular blocks, or separate weather-icon badges. Sunshine occupies the left interior sky, cloud coverage develops naturally toward the right, a few rain strokes appear under the storm cloud, and a few small snow marks plus snow-capped peaks finish the right interior. All weather is fully clipped within the fish silhouette, including the sun. Nothing floats above or outside the fish.

Preserve the recognizability of the reference trout: same right-facing silhouette, broad left tail, angular dorsal and lower fins, dark Oregon-blue boundary #002A86, small round yellow eye in the right head separate from the sun, green lower body #285D45. Preserve ONE clearly legible continuous warm-cream negative-space branching LAKE BILLY CHINOOK-INSPIRED CUTOUT through the lower-middle body: long winding west arm, two southward branches separated by evergreen land, short north connection. The lake channel is one constant geographic mark across the whole fish, not repeated or broken up with the weather. Preserve its approximate existing shape from the reference.

Style: bold, simple, flat illustrated logo with clean edges and broad interlocking color shapes. Keep scenic detail restrained so it still reads as a brand mark. Maintain one shared horizon and coherent landscape. No photorealism, 3D, glossy rendering or intricate decorative textures. Oregon blue, evergreen, cream and yellow with a limited warm-to-cool sky palette. One fish occupies most of the width; confident heavy sans-serif blue wordmark below it. Generous clean margin. The result must immediately read as ONE FISH WITH CHANGING WEATHER INSIDE IT.
